target_team: NORTH for even family index; SOUTH for odd

feature_separation.unit: seed family; paired differences and null-matched change distributions
feature_separation.context: opponent possession, open play, opponent own half; compare ball-zone and score strata

selection: development feature screen; bounded candidate grid; validation selects among active candidates prioritizing null<=0.25, then primary F1, precision, latency and simplicity; freeze before holdout scoring
objective_B: Numerical positioning facts plus complementary observable checks. No pattern-classification precision/recall without independently labeled episodes; do not recycle detector thresholds as labels.
holdout_rules: do not inspect holdout features or scores before final freeze
do not retune on final holdout
exclusions: All Step 1 and all Step 2 seeds; verify exact sets in scripts/tests
data_policy: New large generated data remains local and ignored per Step 2.5 brief. Preserve existing tracked data and history.
reasoning_settings: Current chat tools cannot change the active reasoning setting; no model switch is claimed. Design, freezes and decisions are persisted here.
